$Comment:
What the Crafting tree's station stats pay at the Sawmill. Named by Extensions/SawmillProgression.json and rolled on every completed cycle, and again for each cycle of an unattended pile when its worker gathers it. Each roll reads one of the MMO's shared station stats (Server/Entity/Stats/Station*.json in the MMO jar, each file saying what one point does) through ziggfreedcommon:station_stat at the Sawmill, which at the bench reads exactly the stat and, for a pile gathered later, still counts the talents bound to working here. Every stat is whole percent points read as a Chance, so 25 points is one cycle in four. A talent, a piece of gear carrying the stat (an item's StatModifiers) or a buff (an effect's stat modifiers) all count the same, and with none of them every roll here reads 0 and pays nothing, so a worker without the tree mills exactly as before.

The tree's talents bind their stats While working at the stations they pay at (CommonLib's ZigWorkingAt), so a table talent never pays here: Crafting's main line and Clean Cuts on StationYield_Crafting, Offcut Bin and Second Look on StationFind, Rare Woods and Heart Seeker on StationFind_Rare. In the Grain grants both StationYield_Crafting and StationFind from a session's 20th cycle (ZigWorkingAt's CyclesMin), so the plank roll and the everyday-find roll below pay it with no roll of its own; on a pile gathered away from the bench it counts on every cycle.

The roll that pays planks grants rpgstations:output_items, ONE more of the cycle's own product on a hit, on top of Recipe.Yield and the other ladders. The rolls that repeat a find grant a Lootable reward naming the band to roll again with Trigger Cycle, beside its Treasure Cut twin (Mmo_Sawmill_Treasure_Luck, Mmo_Sawmill_Treasure_Deep): each nested table is judged against this same cycle (the same score, the same Woodcutting gate, the same Mill Trade gates), so a second roll can never pay a tier the first could not, and each player gets the band that is theirs. Their Essence of Life half is Mmo_Sawmill_Find_Essence, a table of its own so Bulk Order's Requires can shut it.

Every number here is balance data; retune by shipping a same-id file from a pack loading after this one.

Rolls.$Comment: Planks: Crafting's station yield (StationYield_Crafting: its main line, a quarter of a point for each Crafting tree point spent, Clean Cuts, and In the Grain from a session's 20th cycle) is the chance of one more plank, held at 100 percent.

Everyday finds again: the everyday-find stat (StationFind: Offcut Bin, Second Look, and In the Grain from a session's 20th cycle) is the chance this cycle rolls the everyday band (SawmillLuckFinds) a second time.

The deep tiers again: the rarest-find stat (StationFind_Rare: Rare Woods, Heart Seeker) is the chance this cycle rolls the deep band (SawmillDeepFinds, still behind its Woodcutting 30 gate) a second time.
